comment:
* A fallback implementation of {@link android.view.VelocityTracker}. The methods its provide * mirror the platform's implementation. * *

It will be used to provide velocity tracking logic for certain axes that may not be * supported at different API levels, so that {@link VelocityTrackerCompat} can provide compat * service to its clients. * *

Currently, it supports AXIS_SCROLL with the default pointer ID.

variables.name: ASSUME_POINTER_STOPPED_MS
variables.comment:
* If there's no data beyond this period of time, we assume that the previous chain of motion
     * from the pointer has stopped, and we handle subsequent data points separately.

variables.name: mLastComputedVelocity
variables.comment: Cached value of the last computed velocity, for a O(1) get operation.

variables.name: mDataPointsBufferSize
variables.comment: Number of data points that are potential velocity calculation candidates.

variables.name: mDataPointsBufferLastUsedIndex
variables.comment:
* The last index in the circular buffer where a data point was added. Irrelevant if {@code
     * dataPointsBufferSize} == 0.

methods.name: void addMovement(@NonNull MotionEvent event)
methods.comment: Adds a motion for velocity tracking.

methods.name: void computeCurrentVelocity(int units)
methods.comment: Same as {@link #computeCurrentVelocity} with {@link Float#MAX_VALUE} as the max velocity.

methods.name: void computeCurrentVelocity(int units, float maxVelocity)
methods.comment: Computes the current velocity with the given unit and max velocity.

methods.name: float getAxisVelocity(int axis)
methods.comment: Returns the computed velocity for the given {@code axis}.

methods.name: private static float kineticEnergyToVelocity(float work)
methods.comment: Based on the formula: Kinetic Energy = (0.5 * mass * velocity^2), with mass = 1.
